canonical_digest_encoding: Sorted-key compact JSON, ASCII escapes, allow_nan=False, UTF-8, one final LF; inherited R1 canonical() exactly
matrix_encoding: R2 row binary format inside R4 matrix envelope; separate little-endian CSR arrays
registry_decoder: Parse each nonempty line; reject malformed nonempty JSON. Blank separators are not scientific rows.
registry_encoding: Each R1 canonical JSON record followed by one additional LF; blank separator lines are retained in hashes
repeatability: Both independent reconstructions used identical frozen bytes; criterion unchanged
